title: How to Create an Unboxing Experience: Ideas, Design & Packaging (2026)
summary: Learn how to create a memorable unboxing experience: packaging design, custom inserts, branded tissue, and box ideas that make customers share every time.
body_markdown:
An unboxing experience is the complete experience a customer has when opening a package, and learning how to create an unboxing experience is one of the most effective ways to make a lasting first impression. From the first look at the box to finding the products and thoughtful details inside, this moment between purchase and product transforms the packaging into part of the brand story and **creates a memorable customer experience.**


‍


*Photo courtesy of Ecovative Design and Hunter Lab*


‍


## What Makes a Great Unboxing Experience?


The best unboxing experiences are intentional from start to finish. Each layer of packaging builds anticipation while reinforcing your brand, turning a simple delivery into a memorable customer experience. Here are five elements that make the biggest impact:


‍


1. **Custom Outer Packaging:** Your shipping box or mailer is the first thing customers see. A custom-printed box with your logo, colors, or messaging immediately sets expectations and creates excitement before the package is even opened. Discover how[custom mailer unboxing experiences can drive customer loyalty →](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-mailer-boxes-unboxing-experience)


‍


1. **Branded Tissue Paper:** Tissue paper adds a premium touch while protecting your products. Custom-printed tissue paper featuring your logo, patterns, or brand colors creates a polished presentation and makes every layer feel intentional.


‍


1. **Custom Inserts:** Foam inserts, molded paper trays, or custom dividers keep products secure while presenting them in an organized, high-end way. Well-designed inserts also make multiple products feel like a curated set rather than items packed together.


‍


1. **A Personal Note:** A handwritten thank-you card, welcome message, or personalized insert helps customers feel appreciated. Even a short note can create a stronger emotional connection and encourage repeat purchases.


‍


1. **Branded Stickers and Seals:** Finishing touches like custom stickers, seals, or branded labels elevate the presentation while reinforcing your visual identity. They also make the package feel thoughtfully assembled and gift-worthy.


‍


By creating[custom packaging](https://www.gemnote.com/capabilities/packaging-sustainability) using durable, eco-friendly materials, you’ll ensure your merch arrives safely while keeping your brand front and center.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Flamingo Estate*


‍


## Why Unboxing Experiences Matter


A great unboxing experience does more than deliver a product—it shapes how customers feel about your brand. From the outer box to the finishing touches inside, every packaging choice influences first impressions, increases perceived value, and reinforces your brand identity.


‍


If you're looking for memorable unboxing experience ideas, start with thoughtful packaging, branded tissue paper, custom inserts, thank-you notes, and premium finishes. These elements encourage customers to share their purchases on social media, generating authentic user-generated content and expanding your brand's reach.


‍


Beyond creating excitement, great packaging builds customer loyalty and helps your business stand out in a competitive market. Whether you're shipping ecommerce orders, employee welcome kits, influencer mailers, or corporate gifts, a thoughtful unboxing experience leaves a lasting impression.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Byredo*


‍


## Best Unboxing Experience Examples


Some of the best unboxing experiences don't rely on expensive packaging—they create a memorable moment through thoughtful design, consistent branding, and attention to detail. Brands like Apple, Glossier, and Allbirds have become well-known for making product delivery an extension of their brand experience. While every company has different goals and budgets, the strategies behind these examples can be adapted for businesses of any size.


‍


### Apple: Minimalist Premium Packaging


Apple's packaging is designed to feel as premium as the product inside. Clean white boxes, precise product placement, and high-quality materials create anticipation from the moment the lid is lifted. Every component has a purpose, resulting in a simple, organized presentation that reinforces Apple's attention to detail.


‍


**Takeaway:** Use premium materials, custom inserts, and thoughtful product placement to create a polished, high-end experience without overwhelming customers.


‍


### Glossier: Social Media-Worthy Presentation


Glossier helped popularize shareable unboxing experiences by combining branded pink bubble mailers, signature stickers, minimalist packaging, and personalized touches. The presentation feels fun, recognizable, and instantly identifiable, encouraging customers to post photos and videos online.


‍


**Takeaway:** Incorporate branded colors, custom tissue paper, stickers, thank-you cards, or small surprise gifts to make your packaging memorable and encourage user-generated content.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Glossier*


‍


### Allbirds: Sustainable Packaging That Reflects the Brand


Allbirds demonstrates that sustainability can be part of the unboxing experience. Its packaging uses recycled and responsibly sourced materials while maintaining a clean, attractive presentation. The box is designed to minimize waste without sacrificing quality, reinforcing the company's environmental values.


‍


**Takeaway:** Eco-friendly packaging, recyclable materials, and minimalist design help communicate your brand values while creating a positive customer experience. Businesses can achieve a similar effect with custom mailer boxes, recycled tissue paper, soy-based inks, and reusable packaging.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Play and Store (left) and NUBE and AURAMA STUDIO (right)*


‍


## Unboxing Experience Packaging Design: Types & Options


The right packaging design sets the tone before a customer even sees your product. From the outer shipping box to the finishing details inside, every packaging element contributes to the overall unboxing experience. Whether you're creating packaging for your[e-commerce store](https://www.gemnote.com/software/e-commerce-store) , employee welcome kits, influencer mailers, or corporate gifts, these packaging options can help turn an ordinary shipment into a memorable brand moment.


‍


### Corrugated Shipping Boxes


[Corrugated shipping boxes](https://www.gemnote.com/products-packaging/corrugated-shipping-boxes) provide the durable outer layer that protects products during transit. Available in a range of sizes and strengths, they can be custom printed with your logo, brand colors, and messaging, allowing your branding to begin before the package is even opened. They're ideal for ecommerce orders, subscription boxes, promotional mailers, and corporate gifting.


‍


### Rigid Boxes


[Custom rigid boxes](https://www.gemnote.com/products-packaging/luxury-rigid-boxes) are one of the most premium packaging options available. Made from thick, durable materials, they're ideal for luxury products, executive gifts, electronics, beauty products, and VIP experiences. Their sturdy construction protects products while creating a high-end presentation that customers associate with quality.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Obakki Brand & Packaging Design by arithmetic _ (left) and Garmentory (right)*


‍


### Custom Mailer Boxes


[Custom mailer boxes](https://www.gemnote.com/products-packaging/mailer-boxes) are the boxes customers actually open. With full-color printing, inside-and-out branding, and custom messaging, they transform ecommerce orders, product launches, subscription boxes, and promotional campaigns into memorable brand experiences while keeping products protected throughout delivery.


‍


### Custom Inserts


[Packaging inserts](https://www.gemnote.com/products-packaging/box-trays-packaging-accessories) keep products secure while enhancing the overall presentation. Depending on your product and budget, options include custom foam inserts, molded paper pulp, corrugated inserts, paper fill, crinkle paper, and recyclable cushioning. Well-designed inserts create a clean, organized presentation while preventing products from shifting during transit.


‍


*Design and photo courtesy of dhowelldesigns (left) and Miriam Escudero Studio (right)*


‍


### Magnetic Closure Boxes


Magnetic closure boxes instantly elevate the unboxing experience with a smooth, premium opening and reusable design. They're a popular choice for executive gifts, luxury merchandise,[PR and influencer kits](https://www.gemnote.com/products/pr-influencer-kits) , and high-value product launches where presentation is just as important as protection.


‍


### Custom Tissue Paper


[Branded tissue paper](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-tissue-paper) adds another layer of anticipation while protecting products from scratches and movement. Custom printing with logos, patterns, or brand colors creates a polished presentation and reinforces your visual identity before customers even reach the product itself.


‍


### Ribbon Pulls


Ribbon pulls make products easier to remove while adding an elegant finishing touch. Often paired with rigid boxes or custom inserts, they create a more interactive unboxing experience and help showcase premium products without adding unnecessary complexity.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Inae Choi on Behance and Pinterest*


‍


### Custom Sticker Seals


[Custom label stickers](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-label-stickers) provide a simple but effective finishing touch while securing your packaging. They can be used to close tissue paper, seal boxes, or reinforce your branding with custom logos, colors, or messaging. Sticker seals are an affordable way to create a cohesive presentation across ecommerce shipments, gift boxes, and promotional kits.


‍


Every packaging element should support your brand story. By combining the right box style, protective inserts, branded wrapping, and finishing details, you can create an unboxing experience that feels intentional, memorable, and uniquely yours.


‍


Photo courtesy of Studio Eclectics for Loon Candles


‍


## How to Design an Unboxing Experience: Packaging That Creates Memorable Moments


A memorable unboxing experience is built one layer at a time. The goal isn't simply to package a product—it's to create anticipation, reinforce your brand, and make every interaction feel intentional. From choosing the right box to adding personalized finishing touches, each packaging decision shapes how customers remember your brand.


‍


### 1. Start with the Right Box


Your box creates the first impression. For everyday ecommerce shipments, custom mailer boxes provide a durable, fully branded solution that's ideal for subscription boxes, product launches, and direct-to-consumer orders. If you're creating a luxury gift, executive kit, or influencer PR package, rigid boxes offer a more premium presentation with a high-end feel.


‍


### 2. Protect Products with Custom Inserts


A great unboxing experience feels organized, not cluttered. Custom inserts hold products securely in place while creating a clean, intentional presentation. Foam inserts provide a premium fit for fragile items, while paper fill, molded pulp, and corrugated inserts offer sustainable alternatives that protect products during shipping.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Mushroom Packaging by Ecovative Design for Hudson Hemp’s Treaty CBD and Sandor Hair*


‍


### 3. Create Layers of Discovery


Adding layers makes opening a package more engaging. Branded tissue paper, ribbon pulls, belly bands, and custom sticker seals build anticipation before customers even reach the product. These details don't have to be expensive—they simply make the experience feel thoughtful and cohesive.


‍


### 4. Reinforce Your Brand Throughout the Experience


Every element inside the box should reflect your brand identity. Custom printing, brand colors, thank-you cards, product information, QR codes, and personalized messages all help tell your story while creating a stronger connection with customers. Consistency across every touchpoint makes your packaging instantly recognizable.


‍


### 5. Choose Sustainable Packaging


Sustainability has become an important part of the customer experience. Choosing recyclable materials, paper-based cushioning, soy-based inks, and reusable packaging can reduce waste while reinforcing your brand values. Explore these[sustainable packaging ideas](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/sustainable-packaging-ideas) to create an unboxing experience that's better for your customers and the planet.


‍


### 6. End with a Memorable Surprise


The best unboxing experience packaging designs often include an unexpected finishing touch. Product samples,[branded stickers](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/branded-stickers) , discount codes, handwritten notes, or exclusive offers give customers another reason to remember—and share—their experience. Small details can have a lasting impact on customer loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.


‍


*Photo courtesy of Yoko and The Everleigh Bottling Co.*


‍


## Bring Your Unboxing Experience to Life


A memorable unboxing experience doesn't require an unlimited budget—it requires thoughtful packaging that reflects your brand and delights your customers. From custom mailer boxes and premium rigid boxes to branded tissue paper, custom inserts, and finishing touches, every packaging decision contributes to the overall customer experience.


‍


Whether you're launching a new product, shipping e-commerce orders, welcoming employees with[new hire kits](https://www.gemnote.com/products/new-hire-kits) , or creating executive gifts, investing in a well-designed unboxing experience can increase perceived value, strengthen customer loyalty, and encourage customers to share your brand with others.

## FAQs


### What is an unboxing experience?


An unboxing experience is the complete experience a customer has when opening a package. It includes everything from the outer box and protective packaging to branded inserts, tissue paper, and personalized details that shape how customers perceive your brand.


‍


### How do you create a memorable unboxing experience?


Start with high-quality packaging, add branded elements like tissue paper and custom inserts, include a thank-you note or surprise gift, and ensure every detail reflects your brand identity. The goal is to create anticipation and make customers feel excited from the moment they receive the package.


‍


### What packaging is best for an unboxing experience?


The best packaging design depends on your product and budget. Popular options include custom mailer boxes, rigid boxes, corrugated shipping boxes, magnetic closure boxes, custom inserts, branded tissue paper, ribbon pulls, custom sticker seals, and sustainable packaging materials.


‍


### Why is the unboxing experience important?


A memorable unboxing experience helps increase perceived product value, strengthens brand recognition, encourages customers to share their purchases on social media, and can improve customer loyalty and repeat purchases.


‍


### What should be included in an unboxing package?


Many brands include branded packaging, protective inserts, tissue paper, thank-you cards, product information, stickers, discount codes, or small promotional gifts. The best unboxing experiences balance presentation with functionality.


‍


### How much does custom packaging cost?


Custom packaging costs vary depending on the box style, materials, printing, order quantity, and finishing options. Simple branded mailer boxes are generally the most budget-friendly, while rigid boxes with custom inserts and premium finishes cost more but provide a more luxurious presentation.


‍


### What makes an unboxing experience memorable?


A memorable unboxing experience combines quality packaging, thoughtful presentation, and personalized details that reflect your brand. Elements like premium boxes, branded tissue paper, custom inserts, thank-you cards, and sustainable packaging all help create a positive first impression that customers remember.
